title: Mining & metals
description: Ozone in gold and metal mining: ore pretreatment, leaching enhancement, cyanide destruction, and metal storage and surface cleaning. Eco-friendly technology for mineral processing and metalworking.

extraction-and-metals.title: Extraction and metals processing
extraction-and-metals.shortDesc: Ozone in gold mining: refractory ore pretreatment, leaching enhancement, cyanide destruction, and metal cleaning

gold-mining-global.title: Ozone in gold mining: global practices (South Africa, Chile, Canada)

cyanide-destruction.title: Ozone cyanide destruction in mining

metal-storage-surface.title: Ozone for metal storage and surface treatment
metal-storage-surface.shortDesc: Cleaning and passivation of metal surfaces with ozone: organic removal, oxide film formation, applications in semiconductors, optics, and aerospace. Corrosion considerations.
